steps.title: Validate plan & get approval
steps.notes: Call validate_plan(PLAN.md content), summarize MCP output and scope, then wait for explicit approval before Execute. If the plan changes → update PLAN.md and validate again. Cancelled/Blocked → do not enter Execute.
